prompt: Edit the FIRST image. It is an animator's layout sheet: 3 posing mannequins in a 3x1 grid, 3 key drawings of him vaulting down a stairwell from one flight of stairs to the next, different from each other: in the FIRST he is diving over a handrail with one hand planted on it, body thrown forward almost level and knees tucked up; in the SECOND he is dropping through the air feet first, arms flung up and wide; in the THIRD he is landing in a deep crouch, knees fully bent, one fist down beside his feet, looking up ahead (reading left to right). Paint the character from the SECOND image (his model sheet) over every mannequin, as 3 finished key drawings by the same animator. The second image only shows what he looks like: do not copy its standing figures, its poses or its arrangement; the result holds exactly the 3 figures of the first image, each in its mannequin's pose and place, and nothing else. For each of the 3: keep every limb exactly where the mannequin has it (same joint positions and angles, same lean, same head position, same size and same place in its cell), so the 3 figures stay the same size as each other. BLUE limbs are his LEFT arm and leg; RED limbs are his RIGHT arm and leg; the darker shade is the upper limb, the lighter the lower. He faces and moves toward the viewer's LEFT, seen exactly from the side (his left side toward the viewer, his face in profile). Each figure has exactly two arms and two legs, and both feet are drawn complete. Wherever his face shows it is fully drawn, with eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth as on the model sheet: never a blank face. All 3 drawings must be the SAME character with IDENTICAL design, colours and details in every drawing: Tane, a 16-year-old boy, stocky and a bit fat with a soft round belly, warm medium-brown skin and thick eyebrows. HAIR: a tall glossy black pompadour swept up and forward, short at the sides and back. COAT: a long plain dark-red coat down to his calves, always worn open, with a high stand-up collar and long sleeves to the wrists; four round gold buttons in a row down the front edge on HIS RIGHT side and nothing else on it; the back of the coat is plain dark red with one centre seam. BELLY WRAP: a white sleeveless undershirt tucked into a wide white cloth wrap wound round his whole belly from chest to waist, drawn with three or four horizontal fold lines. TROUSERS: plain baggy black trousers gathered at the ankles. FEET: bare feet in wooden geta sandals: a plain light-brown wooden block sole with one black V-shaped strap between the toes. HANDS: bare hands, no gloves, no rings. FACE: round cheeks, thick black eyebrows, a wide fearless grin showing his teeth. No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on him. No toothpick, no cigarette, no weapon. Remove every trace of the mannequins: no blue, red, green or grey mannequin colour may remain. Style as the second image: 1990s cel anime: bold clean black ink outlines of even weight, flat colour fills, two tones per material (a base and one hard-edged shade), no gradients, no texture, no soft shading, no motion blur, no speed lines, no ground, no shadows on the ground, no text, no panel borders. Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, also between the legs and inside every gap. Only the character: NO handrail, NO stairs, NO floor, nothing he touches is drawn. He grins with bared teeth in all three, delighted; his long open coat flies up and out behind him, most of all in the second drawing where it balloons up over his back as he falls. His wooden geta sandals stay on his feet.
